name: mindbox
description: Build marketing scenarios, audience filters and emails in a Mindbox project from plain-language requests: flow-create designs and fills a scenario, filter-build builds a platform-confirmed filter, filter-explain reads one back in business terms, email writes an email layout and email-ops previews it, saves it into a campaign and edits the campaign, analytics answers questions about the project's figures from its analytics data, and whypromo explains in plain language why a promotion did not apply to an order, gave no benefit or gave less than expected. Nothing is launched or sent to customers, and no filter is saved as a segment.
